The paper was sat on Saturday 9 April 2022; the 11-page file has a cover page (scientific committee and setters, left out), 40 multiple-choice questions (records 1-40) and two exercises («ΑΣΚΗΣΕΙΣ»: ΑΣΚΗΣΗ 1 and ΑΣΚΗΣΗ 2) made of multiple-choice sub-questions, stored here as records 41 and 42. Compound and element labels are kept as printed (Greek capital letters; in the English text the letters that look like Latin ones are written as Latin letters, while Γ, Δ, Σ, Φ, Ψ and Ω stay Greek); the multiple-choice options Α, Β, Γ, Δ are A, B, C, D in English.

The paper was sat on Saturday 9 April 2022; the 11-page file has a cover page (scientific committee and setters, left out), 40 multiple-choice questions (records 1-40) and two exercises («ΑΣΚΗΣΕΙΣ»: ΑΣΚΗΣΗ 1 and ΑΣΚΗΣΗ 2) made of multiple-choice sub-questions, stored here as records 41 and 42. The file contains no answers or solutions. The paper prints no atomic masses or other data tables. Compound and element labels are kept as printed (Greek capital letters; in the English text the letters that look like Latin ones are written as Latin letters, while Γ, Δ, Σ, Φ, Ψ and Ω stay Greek); the multiple-choice options Α, Β, Γ, Δ are A, B, C, D in English.
